MAS-05.reason: This complete cloak ambition overlaps OPT-01 and ELE-04; no independent component mechanism is identified between the complete targets.

MAS-09.reason: The catalyst/system scope overlaps CHM-05. A second artificial-photosynthesis ambition is not a prerequisite for the first.

MAS-10.reason: No specified ambient topological phase or qubit implementation connects these alternative phase possibilities to a definite device route.

CRM-01.reason: Ductility and hardness are material-property goals. No selected device or fabrication architecture here specifies a qualified use of that combination.

CRM-03.reason: Transparency and theoretical strength do not supply the dynamic optical or imaging functions in the collection; a complete optical design is missing.

CRM-05.reason: The original source flags equivalence to ELE-01. Retain the reference rather than a ceramic-to-superconductor causal arrow.

CRM-06.reason: A possible hot-air vehicle use needs a qualified thermal architecture, processing and loads. No such application mechanism has yet been justified in this batch.

CRM-08.reason: Coupling magnitude does not specify an energy-harvesting, memory or actuator implementation; translating it directly into power or computation would add an unsupported mechanism.

MET-04.reason: Bulk amorphous processing alone does not establish any listed structure’s complete property combination; no qualified part and load case was identified.

MET-05.reason: High elongation is not a construction or assembly process. No target part, strain path and retained-property argument justifies a downstream capability here.

MET-07.reason: A hot oxidizing-atmosphere alloy needs an application-specific load and fabrication route before an engine or propulsion capability can be inferred.

MET-08.reason: Single-crystal perfection alone does not establish the targeted hardness, corrosion or high-temperature property combinations in other alloy goals.

MET-10.reason: This proposed property combination lacks a specified component architecture; using it as a generic strong-materials hub would manufacture coverage.

MEC-07.reason: No qualified propulsor geometry, load regime or vehicle integration is specified by a downstream system reviewed in this batch.

CIV-07.reason: The target overlaps STR-05’s universal collapse-arrest ambition. Neither complete goal is a separate causal input to the other.

STR-05.reason: The source overlaps CIV-07’s collapse-prevention goal. Preserve both source entries without inventing a causal sequence.

IND-06.reason: No network mechanism is specified that guarantees continuity under arbitrary shocks without buffers or extra cost. Related optimization targets do not establish that guarantee.

NUC-03.reason: Transmutation completeness and a closed fuel cycle are different goals; no specified reactor/target process connects this universal waste-removal ambition to another complete system.

NUC-09.reason: No reviewed material-accounting, separation and safeguarding design establishes the stated no-weapons-usable-material architecture; waste transmutation alone would not suffice.

PWR-07.reason: The gigawatt, long-distance wireless system has no qualified source, propagation and receiver architecture in these entries. ELE-02 is an overlapping transfer ambition, not a prerequisite.

CHE-01.reason: Universal perfect separation at essentially zero energy requires a feasibility and process model before use as a component; a generic separation-to-every-plant arrow was rejected.

rejectedCandidates.reason: A ceramic oxidation barrier does not establish a coating-free alloy; the material requirements differ.
Electrolyte energy density alone does not establish seasonal storage economics, loss and lifetime.
